text:
taylor: Hey @sam — quick ask from PMM: we need a small verified benchmark appendix for the launch post and webinar. Must include p50/p95, tokens/sec, and cost/1M tokens, plus the exact commands and commit for reproducibility. Can eng/runtime run a reproducible sweep this week?

sam: Yep. Which models/variants/seqs/hw do you want? Also confirm whether you want warmup protocol and raw logs.

taylor: Target models: redwood-3B (fp16), redwood-3B-quant (int8), and an external 3B baseline (for fair play). Sequences: 64, 256, 512. Batches: 1 and 4. Hardware: primary A100-80GB; optional lower-cost comparison on g4dn. We want raw logs plus a summarized CSV. Include brief methodology blurb and a one-liner reproducibility command.

sam: Understood. Plan: smoke tonight (single run per combo) and full sweep Thu (5 runs each). Warmup: 30 tokens, runs seeded. Payloads: marketing_scrubbed.csv on S3 + synthetic uniform-length file for normalization. I'll post the exact CLI I use.

chris: Legal/PMM note: copy should say "measured on A100-80GB under the described configuration; see artifacts for full details". Also avoid comparative claims that imply customer outcomes.

sam: Noted. Draft one-liner to include in the appendix: `python infra/bench/run_bench.py --model redwood-3B --variant fp16 --batch 1 --seq 256 --runs 50 --seed 2026 --hw a100-80gb --payloads s3://redwood-marketing/marketing_scrubbed.csv --emit-raw-logs s3://redwood-marketing/bench-raw/1835000001/`. Full-runbook entry will list all combos.

bench-bot: job 1835000001-smoke submitted by sam; queued on a100 cluster (ETA ~30m).

sam: Smoke finished — quick numbers (seq256 batch1, a100): redwood-3B fp16 p50 21ms p95 58ms tokens/sec 1100 cost_per_1M $9.5. redwood-3B-quant int8 p50 19ms p95 64ms tokens/sec 1150 cost_per_1M $4.2. external-3B fp16 p50 25ms p95 90ms tokens/sec 980 cost_per_1M $10.7. Raw artifacts: s3://redwood-marketing/bench-raw/1835000001/; commit: e7b4f1a; seed: 2026.

taylor: Great — please add a short variability note for the deck (warmup, instance placement, network). Also export CSV columns: model_variant, hw, batch, seq, p50_ms, p95_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1M_tokens.

sam: Added language: "Results are median over N runs after a short warmup; variability can occur due to instance placement, IO, and background processes. See raw artifacts for per-run traces." CSV exported with requested columns. Full sweep scheduled Thu morning, priority high. I'll drop artifacts here when ready.

taylor: Thanks all — that'll work for the appendix. Please ping once full artifacts are in so we can lock the deck. :rocket:
